title: Tweety and the Magic Gems
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Board position, gems
Looney Tunes board game: roll, move around the board and land on spaces

rows: collect the magic gems before the other players
Tweety and other Looney Tunes (Sylvester, Granny and friends)

widgets.text: Each space type does something: gems, minigames, events

Minigames on spaces
Minigames decide who wins items or gems; practice them from the minigame menu

Boards
Several boards, each with its own layout and events
Boards differ in size and events; minigames trigger on certain spaces
The board is a world map with cities (e.g. Hong Kong), shops and exits; character points are spent in shops

Magic gems
Gems are the score; some spaces steal or swap them
Character points (shown at the top) and gems are your resources; shops sell items

Gems collected
Minigames unlocked by playing boards
Magic gems are the goal; minigames are unlocked as you play

Boards cleared
Boards cleared; most gems wins
The player with the most gems at the end of the board wins
